primary.name: The Future of the AI-Driven Research Ecosystem, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
primary.format: 9-page long or 4-page short research paper, references and appendices excluded
primary.fit_basis: The official call explicitly prioritizes empirical and technical work on producing, representing, verifying, composing, and evaluating AI-driven research.

secondary.name: Who Verifies the Agents?, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
secondary.format: 4 to 9 pages, references and appendices excluded
secondary.fit_basis: The official call covers verifier robustness, evaluation-harness red teaming, environment-grounded verification, and agents that verify other agents.

completion_condition: One selected topic has verified closest-prior differentiation, a strong baseline, real repeated experiments, uncertainty and error analysis, claim-to-evidence mapping, a reproducibility bundle, an official template, independent review and meta-review, passing repository validation, and a reviewable commit.

archive_policy.import_requirement: A current evidence ticket must identify the exact claim, source, verification depth, and reason for reuse.

hard_gates: two distinct verified full-text closest priors
real task or defensible controlled benchmark unit
metric and paired or clustered uncertainty plan
bounded local compute and storage estimate
no empirical claim from codex_mock or synthetic fixtures
official venue scope and deadline basis

topic_null_contract.title: Agents Under Null Probe
topic_null_contract.reason: Current literature absorbs protected hidden-holdout enforcement, adaptive validation controls, untouched holdout transfer, and prompt-versus-runtime comparisons; a broad research-method claim is therefore not defensible.

topic_relation_serialization.title: Information-Equivalent Verdict Invariance Probe
topic_relation_serialization.research_question: Under information-equivalent serializations of identical SCITAB canonical atoms, how often do scientific-table claim verdicts flip, and how much does single-format evaluation hide that vulnerability?
probe_requirements: freeze a 60-paper primary sample with 30 supports and 30 refutes after parser audits
no outcome-driven sample replacement and no promotion below 40 valid paper-unique units
not-enough-info examples are secondary and cannot promote the topic
gold labels may be used only by the frozen balancing and grading steps and are never exposed to renderers, prompts, retries, or models
natural row-statement and typed JSON variants use the exact same canonical cells
token-ratio audit and its acceptance rule are frozen before inference
row and column permutations are matched across serialization conditions
three-way labels and permutation consistency are scored by an exact deterministic grader without a model judge
two local model families are evaluated
paired statistics use paper-level units and account for all matched conditions
per-format macro-F1 and any format-winner contrast are secondary and cannot promote the topic
claims are limited to the tested renderers, model families, and pinned SCITAB commit

primary.paired_verdict_disagreement: For the same paper-level item and matched permutation, whether natural row statements and typed JSON produce different exact verdicts.
primary.paired_verdict_invariance: One minus paired verdict disagreement, reported without selecting a preferred format.
primary.worst_case_correctness: A paper-level item is correct only when every tested renderer-by-permutation view receives the exact gold verdict.
primary.single_format_hidden_vulnerability: For each renderer separately, standalone exact correctness minus worst-case correctness; both gaps are reported without declaring a winner.

endpoint_policy.promotion_rule: Promotion requires a bounded, replicated invariance or hidden-vulnerability result across both local model families; a format-winner result alone cannot promote.

topic_relation_serialization.claim_ceiling: Conclusions are limited to the tested deterministic natural row-statement and typed JSON renderers, matched permutation schedule, two local model families, and SCITAB commit 217cfbd71ebf39ba26a0938f0d87a9fce560e0fe. No general JSON-versus-natural-language superiority claim is allowed.
topic_relation_serialization.kill_reason: The frozen manual-audit contract requires every record in the fixed 70-row universe to pass. The binding audit failed 39 records. Replacement, expansion, threshold reduction, and model inference are forbidden.

topic_review_backtracking.title: Artifact-Grounded Revision Closure
topic_review_backtracking.research_question: When a scientific revision requires code or experiment changes, can a typed obligation plus execution receipt distinguish a completed repair from an unsupported completion claim better than paper-only comparison, trace-only review, or file-diff presence?
remaining_hard_gates: licensed real unit with deterministic closure label
at least two meaningful obligation classes
bounded local context and inference estimate

topic_grader_conform.title: Do Contract-Based Metamorphic Tests Find Historical Bugs in Agent Evaluators? A Blinded Cross-Repository Study
topic_grader_conform.research_question: Under equal information and execution budgets, how often do contract-based metamorphic tests produce executable reproducers for retained historical agent-evaluator faults compared with direct example regressions, free-form contract-aware property tests, and auditor-to-reproducer baselines?
topic_grader_conform.narrow_claim_boundary: grader-local, contract-expressible false accepts and false rejects under deterministic artifact, response, trace, state, or invocation-context transformations
v1_kill_reasons: eligibility was entangled with relation-template applicability
the old 109 admits cannot define the v2 denominator
baseline information and control independence were not symmetric enough for a confirmatory claim
the formulation overstated method novelty relative to established metamorphic and property-based testing
v2_preflight_requirements: re-adjudicate all 178 retained candidates without relation or template applicability
sample 24 eligible faults from at least 6 repositories or independent clusters by a public deterministic rule
freeze 12 normal, 12 unrelated-change, and 12 intentional-contract-change controls from at least 6 repositories
give every arm the same parent snapshot, contract evidence, schema, native tests, environment, and execution budget
freeze three strong baselines and an independent replay schema before any method outcome is observed
kill and switch topics if sampling independence, information symmetry, control validity, or budget parity fails bounded preflight

v2_kill_decision.reason: The bounded preflight cannot close its isolated eligibility, global deduplication, negative-control, source-packet, and freeze requirements, while the broad claim is compositionally absorbed by direct prior work.

topic_user_simulator_conditional_ranking.title: Profile-Conditional Assistant Ranking with User Simulators
topic_user_simulator_conditional_ranking.research_question: Do assistant rankings produced by user simulators remain valid within user-profile strata rather than only in aggregate?

verified_primary_sources.finding: SimulatorArena derives high-level knowledge, preference, writing-style, interaction-style, and message-length attributes from the completed real human-LLM conversation used as the behavioral target.

The repository provides 459 document conversations, 450 redacted math conversations, and GPT-4o-extracted per-conversation profiles, but simulation and evaluator outputs are runtime directories rather than committed row-level results.

kill_reasons: The proposed prospective profile-conditional validity claim would condition on attributes extracted from the complete target dialogue, introducing post-dialogue information leakage.
The public repository does not contain the row-level simulator and evaluator outputs needed to reanalyze assistant rankings without new model runs.

A leakage-safe version requires profiles available before interaction, newly executed simulator-assistant conversations, and profile-stratified human comparison data; the current public artifact alone cannot support the claim.
The required new multi-model, multi-turn simulator and evaluator runs are not a quick local-only study under the current no-paid-provider evidence boundary.
topic_user_simulator_conditional_ranking.remaining_narrow_route: A future study may test profile-conditional ranking only with pre-interaction profile fields, outcome-blind strata, newly generated simulator runs, and an independently held-out human comparison set.
topic_user_simulator_conditional_ranking.claim_ceiling: The current public data can support retrospective descriptive analyses of conversation-derived profiles, not prospective conditional-ranking validity.

topic_temporal_selective_reobservation.title: Selective Reobservation for Time-Evolving Web Tasks

verified_primary_sources.finding: SentinelBench already evaluates 100 time-evolving tasks across 10 web environments and measures completion, reaction time, and resource use.
Its wait_for baseline captures page snapshots once per second, deduplicates diff blocks, adaptively rate-limits model checks, reloads periodically, and directly compares against sleep.
The public harness ships 100 scenarios, deterministic SQL evaluation, resumable runs, and a maximum four-times simulation speed.

topic_temporal_selective_reobservation.kill_reason: The broad time-aware selective-observation claim is compositionally absorbed by SentinelBench and its diff-driven wait_for baseline; reproducing it locally would be expensive and scientifically incremental.
topic_temporal_selective_reobservation.remaining_narrow_route: Select which currently unobserved page or functional region to sense next without first reading the full page state.
topic_temporal_selective_reobservation.narrow_route_blocker: The route must prove a non-privileged acquisition boundary and functional non-equivalence to wait_for before any pilot.

topic_multilingual_typed_tool_normalizat.title: Schema-Selective Canonicalization for Multilingual Tool Arguments

verified_primary_sources.finding: MLCL directly identifies parameter-language mismatch and compares direct prompting, explicit parameter-language prompting, pre-translation, and post-translation.
BenchMAX provides 318 source tasks translated into 17 languages; language rows are repeated measurements rather than independent units.
The evaluator performs exact function-and-argument comparison but loads API definitions from a separate Hugging Face dataset.
The pinned repository README states that evaluation notebooks and evaluation data are Apache-2.0, and the notebooks embed API definitions, but the linked CODE_LICENSE file is absent from that commit.

outcome_blind_data_audit.warning: Role counts are exploratory because the current census infers semantic types from field names and descriptions.

hold_reasons: The exact NexusRaven API evaluation dataset used by BenchMAX has no explicit license in its Hugging Face card metadata.
The current semantic-role census is heuristic and cannot serve as a preregistered taxonomy.
Only 79 source tasks are normalizable under the exploratory rule, below the independently proposed 100-task pilot floor.
topic_multilingual_typed_tool_normalizat.remaining_narrow_route: Test schema-selective canonicalization only after a source-grounded field taxonomy, an exact licensed schema manifest, and a power-aware independent-unit floor are frozen.

topic_scope_preserving_report_revision.title: Scope-Preserving Evidence-Grounded Revision

verified_primary_sources.finding: MR DRE directly studies report revision under outside-feedback preservation constraints using localized edit plans and break-rate evaluation.
FactCorrector uses atomic claims and claim-evidence structure while measuring preservation of already-correct claims.

topic_scope_preserving_report_revision.kill_reason: Localized, evidence-grounded revision with preservation constraints is already a direct research object; changing the contract syntax alone would be incremental.
topic_scope_preserving_report_revision.remaining_narrow_route: Measure whether mechanically enforced source-ID and claim-ID patch binding adds benefit under information- and format-matched controls.
topic_scope_preserving_report_revision.narrow_route_blocker: A licensed gold conversion audit and evidence that direct baselines lack equivalent mechanical binding are required.

topic_structured_output_boundary_attribu.title: Repair-Boundary Attribution for Structured-Output Failures

verified_primary_sources.finding: JSONSchemaBench already evaluates real-world schemas, constrained-decoder coverage, efficiency, and output quality.
Recent failure-localization work already attributes pipeline failures using preserved intermediate artifacts and the first wrong commitment.
Loc2Repair directly separates localization from repair and measures held-out repair success under matched runtime conditions.
A merged structured-output fault includes parent failure, frontend repair, CPU regression tests, and a real-server survival check, demonstrating that usable public lineages exist.

topic_structured_output_boundary_attribu.remaining_narrow_route: Build a licensed corpus of real bug-fix lineages with counterfactual replay to identify minimal sufficient repair-boundary sets, then test whether that attribution improves held-out patch success.
topic_structured_output_boundary_attribu.narrow_route_blocker: At least 12 balanced, cleanly replayable faults are needed before a pilot; dependency recovery rather than GPU inference is the dominant three-day risk.

topic_time_sliced_prior_absorption.title: Time-Sliced Direct-Prior Absorption Detection

verified_primary_sources.finding: RINoBench already evaluates idea-to-literature comparison, known-versus-new aspects, scalar novelty, and literature-grounded explanations.
ScholarEval performs idea-level contribution assessment using only literature available before an idea-specific cutoff and proposes improvements.
InnoEval combines pre-time knowledge evaluation with post-time evidence for idea revision.

topic_time_sliced_prior_absorption.kill_reason: Time slicing, direct-prior comparison, residual novelty assessment, and idea revision are already covered by direct prior work; the broad candidate does not define a distinct research object.
topic_time_sliced_prior_absorption.remaining_narrow_route: A claim-level counterfactual absorption benchmark with evidence spans, typed residual facets, and prior-addition/removal monotonicity.
topic_time_sliced_prior_absorption.narrow_route_blocker: The route requires licensed claim-level gold, at least two independent annotators, lineage-level splits, and evidence that it is not merely a composition of RINoBench, ScholarEval, InnoEval, CitationR, and MasterSet.

topic_tiny_pilot_promotion_policy.title: Evidence-Calibrated Promotion from Tiny Pilots

verified_primary_sources.finding: aLTT already applies sequential multiple testing and early stopping to costly hyperparameter selection with finite-sample guarantees.
RG-PT jointly controls false discovery and resource cost for hyperparameter selection.
Recent Bayesian hybrid shrinkage work directly treats noisy winner selection and regret.

topic_tiny_pilot_promotion_policy.kill_reason: The decision object, low-fidelity evidence, multiplicity, promotion policy, and regret endpoints are directly covered by multi-fidelity HPO, ranking-and-selection, and sequential risk-control research; no agent-specific independent unit or new policy remains.
topic_tiny_pilot_promotion_policy.remaining_narrow_route: An offline diagnostic benchmark for joint low-fidelity, multiplicity, and seed noise using real research-agent project traces.
topic_tiny_pilot_promotion_policy.narrow_route_blocker: Public HPO tables do not contain research-agent project units; reentry requires real agent traces or a policy or guarantee not absorbed by aLTT, RG-PT, OCBA, Hyperband, and shrinkage baselines.

topic_artifact_aware_reviewer_defect_det.title: Artifact-Aware Scientific Defect Review

verified_primary_sources.finding: SciCoQA already evaluates paper-code discrepancy detection with 92 real and 543 synthetic discrepancies and information-access conditions.
ReproRepo statically audits 1,149 paper-repository pairs using real reproducibility issues.
REPRO-Bench evaluates automated reproducibility assessment from papers and reproduction packages.

topic_artifact_aware_reviewer_defect_det.kill_reason: The proposed manuscript-only versus artifact-aware contrast confounds reviewer ability with information access, context, tools, and compute; adjacent paper-code discrepancy and reproducibility benchmarks already cover the broad research object.
topic_artifact_aware_reviewer_defect_det.remaining_narrow_route: Measure the incremental defect recall from active execution beyond static paper-code-trace auditing under matched information, tool, and compute budgets.
topic_artifact_aware_reviewer_defect_det.narrow_route_blocker: The route requires at least 24 licensed independent package lineages, deterministic non-equivalent mutations, a strong static baseline, and a blinded pilot showing at least 10 percentage points of active-execution recall gain without excessive clean-package false positives.

topic_agent_resume_crash_consistency.title: Crash-Consistency Audit of Stateful Agent Resume Protocols

verified_primary_sources.finding: Atomix directly defines post-effect pre-return failures and compares checkpoint replay with transaction, persistent effect tracking, and idempotency mechanisms.
ACRFence directly demonstrates duplicate external effects after checkpoint restore and proposes an effect-log replay-or-fork gate.
Cordon provides task-scoped transactional isolation with effect outboxes, recovery logs, and idempotency metadata.

topic_agent_resume_crash_consistency.remaining_narrow_route: Reproduce real SIGKILL crash windows and durable write ordering across AppWorld and tau task families while correcting the independent scientific unit.
topic_agent_resume_crash_consistency.narrow_route_blocker: The route must reproduce the official Atomix Tx-Full baseline, preserve benchmark state across process death, expose at least 40 independent effectful units per benchmark, and find a new failure class or a material cost or validity difference rather than merely restating distributed-systems idempotency.

topic_localized_scientific_source_repair.title: Consequence Localization versus Causal Edit-Site Repair under Hard Patch Contracts

dataset_preflight.critical_distinction: Evidence or consequence locations and causal mutation locations must remain separate variables.

topic_localized_scientific_source_repair.remaining_narrow_route: Test whether explicit separation of consequence localization from causal edit-site localization improves exact safe repair under equal budgets and a hard patch contract.
topic_localized_scientific_source_repair.narrow_route_blocker: Before selection, independently reproduce gold representability and pinned-build rates, resolve source redistribution rights, implement the strongest deterministic and soft-minimal baselines, and verify that the narrow contrast is not absorbed by the closest repair systems.

topic_evidence_ceiling_scientific_revisi.title: Evidence-Ceiling-Preserving Scientific Revision
topic_evidence_ceiling_scientific_revisi.remaining_narrow_route: Compare evidence-aware revision against deterministic template and equal-compute generic repair baselines across independent claim families.
topic_evidence_ceiling_scientific_revisi.narrow_route_blocker: The primary endpoint currently requires substantial blinded human evaluation, so this route does not yet satisfy the fast-local-study constraint.

topic_atomic_review_obligation_evaluatio.title: Atomic Obligation Evaluation for Scientific Review
topic_atomic_review_obligation_evaluatio.remaining_narrow_route: Evaluate review quality at atomic obligation level against premise-matched and strongest prior comparators.
topic_atomic_review_obligation_evaluatio.narrow_route_blocker: The current design requires a large scoring workload and human gold annotations, exceeding the intended rapid local preflight budget.

provisional_dispositions_pending_main_ve.remaining_narrow_route: source-declaration to wire-schema to decoder to post-validator boundary attribution

provisional_dispositions_pending_main_ve.reason: Direct priors absorb the central metric family and the public artifact lacks complete action-aligned uncertainty fields and repeated independent trials.
A narrow localization-versus-edit-site contrast may survive, but closest-prior non-overlap, pinned-build feasibility, and per-paper source rights remain unresolved.
The route is falsifiable but its current primary human-evaluation burden conflicts with the fast-local-study constraint.
Broad novelty is absorbed and the surviving controlled comparison exceeds the current local scoring and annotation budget.

post_no_pass_portfolio.next_action: Wide resampling across a different research object, evidence modality, and evaluation unit; held narrow routes remain comparison points rather than default winners.

next_allowed_state: Re-run build, focused, public-sanitization, harness, TUI, and Web validation against the completed provenance, semantic-reentry, and prior-absorption contracts; then widely resample research objects, evidence modalities, and evaluation units from current primary literature rather than promoting a held narrow route by default. Independently verify and score every surviving candidate, select only one with explicit data rights, an executable strongest baseline, enough independent units, bounded local cost, and a predeclared kill signal, and freeze an outcome-blind protocol before any model or study-arm execution. Paper drafting remains forbidden until a real selected study passes execution and review gates.
